notes.title: Devlog #1 — First Look at the Game in Action!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share something special: our very first devlog is now live![/p][p][/p][p]In this short video, we talk about what we’ve been working on, show some early gameplay, and (yes) sneak in a few memes along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]📺 Watch the devlog on YouTube:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bbN0AjzfGiI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]👉 Since this is our first attempt at doing a devlog, we’d really appreciate your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Your input will help us make better updates going forward — both in terms of the game and how we share our progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for being here with us![/p]

notes.title: We're going to gamescom 2025!
notes.content: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]We're excited to announce that our team will be attending [url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]gamescom 2025[/url] as guests this year. [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to meet fellow developers, players, and fans — and to share more about our game in person.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to learn more about our first game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665310/Life_Souls/"]Life Souls[/url] — let’s connect![/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to message us here or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/ZWjQRgjyJH"]Discord [/url]if you’d like to meet up or chat during the event.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in Cologne![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665423/04f98d2c3d87de885d53ad3fc0493812065b511d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Journey Begins
notes.content: [p]Hello, [/p][p]We are a young indie game studio driven by a shared dream — to create our own game. Now, we're turning that dream into reality.[/p][p]Currently, we're working on our first project: Life Souls — a co-op Roguelike Action-RPG. The game is in active development, with plans to release a demo version and enter early access in the near future.[/p][p]Add our game to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665310/Life_Souls/" style="button"]Wishlist[/url] and join our [url="https://discord.gg/ZWjQRgjyJH" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p]We'll be sharing regular behind-the-scenes updates on our development process — and we’d be happy to chat with you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665423/a35a8a1d8fda9df3df1f80ddb77c30bcd053cfe0.png"][/img][/p]
